lines.en: label saraspring5:
scene nightsky
In the wettest part of town, two girls who were very commonly wet in a more sexual context were about to become even more wet in a mostly non-sexual context.
lines.zh: 在镇上最湿漉漉的那个角落，两个平日里常以另一种更性意味的方式湿透的女孩，即将在一种大体无关性的方式下变得更湿。

lines.en: scene daughterbath1
At least for now. But who could say what the night would devolve into when they’ve both pleasured themselves to the sound of the other one fucking at least once now?
lines.zh: 至少眼下是这样。可既然她们俩都至少有过一次听着对方做爱的声音自慰的经历，谁说得准这一夜会演变成什么？

lines.en: The smaller one had made her place known. But the larger one, albeit not much larger, was still feeling somewhat conflicted by the whole thing with her teenage daughter taking dicks the size of her torso.
lines.zh: 小的那个已经亮明了立场。可大的那个——虽说也大不了多少——对整件事仍有些纠结：她那十几岁的女儿，正在吞下差不多有她躯干那么大的鸡巴。

lines.en: The tears and the anguish had vanished for the moment, though. For tonight, she planned on actually talking to her. And the best place to do that was somewhere she couldn’t drink away the worries.
lines.zh: 不过眼泪和痛苦暂时消失了。今晚，她打算真的跟她好好谈一次。而最适合谈的地方，是一个她没法借酒消愁的地方。

lines.en: She could drown them, though. And if Sana refused to abide by her new set of rules, Sara would kill her in front of this group of unsuspecting, pastel-colored civilians.
lines.zh: 不过她可以把它们淹死。而如果 Sana 不肯遵守她新定的规矩，Sara 会在这群毫无戒心、色调柔和的平民面前杀了她。

lines.en: She would then kill herself. Then her family would be reunited either above or below ground and the guy who’s currently fucking the female members would have to wait a little while until he could do that again.
lines.zh: 然后她会自杀。然后她的家人会在天上或地下团聚，而那个正在操她们家女人的男人，得再等上一阵才能重操旧业。

lines.en: Of course, this was all just speculation. For it was equally plausible that one of them would just finger the other or something. I don’t really know.
lines.zh: 当然，这些都只是猜测。因为同样说得通的是，她们中的一个只是用手指捅另一个什么的。我真的不知道。

lines.en: I just know that, whatever it is that happens, it’ll be far easier for the one of them who isn’t used to caring.
lines.zh: 我只知道，不管发生什么，对她们之中那个不习惯在乎的人来说，都会容易得多。

lines.en: At least not about the things she should.
lines.zh: 至少不习惯在乎那些她本该在乎的事。

lines.en: : It’s been a while since we’ve done something like this together, hasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我们好久没一起做这种事了，对吧？

lines.en: : Have we...ever done something like this together?
lines.zh: : 我们……有一起做过这种事吗？

lines.en: : Of course! I used to bathe with you all the time when you were little. Back when we could still fit in the tub together.
lines.zh: : 当然有！你小的时候我老跟你一起洗澡。那时候我们还塞得进同一个浴缸。

lines.en: scene daughterbath2
: We probably still could if we tried...I’m just not sure how...necessary that would be at our age.
lines.zh: : 要是试试的话，大概现在也塞得进……我只是不确定到了我们这个年纪……还有没有必要。

lines.en: : You’re right. And it also probably wouldn’t be the best place to have a conversation.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。而且那大概也不是聊天的最佳场所。

lines.en: scene daughterbath3
: Right...are you sure this place is, though?
lines.zh: : 对……可你确定这儿就是吗？

lines.en: : Because I know what you want to talk to me about, and I’m not sure it’s something other people should be around for...
lines.zh: : 因为我知道你想跟我谈什么，我不确定那种事该有别人在场……

lines.en: : It’ll...be fine as long as we keep our voices down. And I don’t start having a panic attack.
lines.zh: : 只要……我们小声点就没事。还有，只要我不恐慌发作。

lines.en: : Do you feel like you’re about to have a panic attack?
lines.zh: : 你觉得自己快恐慌发作了？

lines.en: : Like, right now? Or just in general? Because I pretty much always feel like I’m going to have one.
lines.zh: : 是指现在？还是一直？因为我基本上一直都觉得自己快发作了。

lines.en: : Okay. But are you closer to doing that now than you normally would be?
lines.zh: : 好吧。可你现在比平时更接近发作吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
scene daughterbath4
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : You know we don’t have to do this, right? You can just ignore what happened if you think that’s easier.
lines.zh: : 你知道我们不必非得这么做的吧？你要是觉得装作没发生过更轻松，那就装。

lines.en: : As your mother, I feel like that would be extremely irresponsible of me.
lines.zh: : 作为你的母亲，我觉得那样太不负责了。

lines.en: : And as your daughter, I probably shouldn’t have invited you to a-
lines.zh: : 而作为你的女儿，我大概不该邀请你来——

lines.en: scene daughterbath5
: Shh! Wait until we’re in a more private spot at least!
lines.zh: : 嘘！至少等我们到一个更私密的地方！

lines.en: scene black
: Okay...but I’ll tell you again...we don’t have to do this...
lines.zh: : 好吧……但我再说一遍……我们不必非得这么做……

lines.en: : Yeah...we kind of do.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我们其实非做不可。

lines.en: scene daughterbath6
: Aaaah...there’s nothing like a nice, hot bath after a long day. Don’t you agree, Sana?
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊……漫长的一天之后，没什么比泡个舒服的热水澡更棒的了。你说呢，Sana？

lines.en: : I can think of at least one thing even better than that.
lines.zh: : 我至少能想到一件比那更棒的事。

lines.en: scene daughterbath7
: You’re not giving me any time to ease into things at all, are you?
lines.zh: : 你是一点缓冲的时间都不肯给我，是吧？

lines.en: : And give you another chance to avoid bringing it up?...You should see this as me doing you a favor.
lines.zh: : 再给你一次机会绕开话题？……你应该把这看成我在帮你忙。

lines.en: : A...favor.
: Right. If you’re so sure that we have to talk about it, as your daughter, I should help you out so you don’t keep running away or getting drunk to ignore the elephant in the room.
lines.zh: : 对。既然你这么确定我们非谈不可，那作为你的女儿，我就该帮你一把，免得你一直逃避，或者靠喝醉来无视房间里那头大象。

lines.en: scene daughterbath8
: You laugh, but no amount of drinking can mask the presence of an...elephant the size of your teacher.
lines.zh: : 你笑吧，可再怎么喝也掩盖不了一头……跟你老师那么大的大象的存在。

lines.en: : I can’t tell if...that’s about his penis or not...
lines.zh: : 我不确定……那是在说他的鸡巴，还是不是……

lines.en: : It wasn’t supposed to be...But it is pretty massive, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 本来不是……不过它确实挺巨大的，是吧？

lines.en: : Huge.
lines.zh: : 巨大。

lines.en: scene daughterbath9
: Did it hurt? The first time you guys...you know...
lines.zh: : 疼吗？你们第一次……那个的时候……

lines.en: : That’s...how you want to start this discussion? By asking me how much it hurt?
lines.zh: : 你就……想这么开始这场谈话？问我有多疼？

lines.en: : That’s the beginning, isn’t it? I feel like I should ask you everything if I want to better understand what’s...going on here, Sana.
lines.zh: : 那不就是开头吗？我觉得要是想更好地理解现在到底……是怎么回事，Sana，我就该把什么都问一遍。

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s all that hard to understand, Mom...
lines.zh: : 我觉得这没那么难理解，妈……

lines.en: scene daughterbath10
: You’ve been in my shoes before. You should know better than anyone what I’m going through.
lines.zh: : 你以前也处在我的位置。你该比任何人都清楚我在经历什么。

lines.en: : I like Sensei...and I was tired of sitting around and waiting for him to make the first move, so I did it.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢 Sensei……我受够了一直坐着等他先迈出那一步，所以我就自己来了。

lines.en: : When? How long has this been going on?
lines.zh: : 什么时候？这事儿持续多久了？

lines.en: scene daughterbath11
: Over a year ago if you’re not counting, like...actual sex. He fingered me at Ayane’s house. She wasn’t happy about that when I told her.
lines.zh: : 要是不算……真正的性交，那得一年多前了。他在 Ayane 家用手把我弄了。我告诉她之后，她可不怎么高兴。

lines.en: : I assume she also told you she came to the bar to talk to me about you then?
lines.zh: : 那我猜，她也跟你说过，她来酒吧找我谈过你的事？

lines.en: scene daughterbath12
: No...but I kind of had a feeling she would. Especially after she and the other girls tried to make me feel bad about asking you to join me at the love hotel.
lines.zh: : 没有……不过我有点预感她会。尤其是在她和别的女孩试图让我为邀请你一起去情人酒店的事感到愧疚之后。

lines.en: : And...you don’t feel bad about that?
lines.zh: : 而……你对此不觉得愧疚？

lines.en: : Of course not. Which is why I told them they just didn’t understand how we are. How we’re different from a...normal family.
lines.zh: : 当然不。所以我才跟她们说，她们根本不懂我们是什么样的。不懂我们和……普通家庭有什么不同。

lines.en: scene daughterbath13
: Different...how, Sana? I don’t understand what you mean by that.
lines.zh: : 不同……在哪儿，Sana？我不明白你是什么意思。

lines.en: : Well, we’re not...close the way a lot of people like us are. You had me at a young age and...you’re just as much of a friend as you are a mom, I think.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们的……亲密方式和很多像我们这样的人不一样。你很年轻就生了我，而且……我觉得你既像妈妈，也同样像个朋友。

lines.en: : Only because my parents never gave me the freedom I give you.
lines.zh: : 那只是因为我的父母从没给过我我给你的这种自由。

lines.en: scene daughterbath14
: You had enough freedom to get knocked up by your teacher, though.
lines.zh: : 可你的自由足够让你被老师搞大肚子。

lines.en: : Sana! That...I...
lines.zh: : Sana！那……我……

lines.en: scene daughterbath15
: Don’t get me wrong...I’m not trying to guilt you for that or anything. I’m just saying that...I can sort of relate to you in a way I can’t with any other adult I know...
lines.zh: : 别误会……我不是想拿那件事让你内疚什么的。我只是说……在某种意义上，我跟你能产生共鸣，这是我对其他任何成年人都做不到的……

lines.en: : Because I’m your mother.
lines.zh: : 因为我是你母亲。

lines.en: : You are. But you’re also a pervert with the same taste in boys who knows how to get their attention. I am what I am because of you.
lines.zh: : 你是。可你也是个变态，跟我口味一样，还知道怎么吸引男孩子的注意。我之所以是我，全是因为你。

lines.en: : You don’t need to remind me...That’s not something I’m proud of, Sana.
lines.zh: : 用不着你提醒我……那不是什么让我骄傲的事，Sana。

lines.en: : Why not? I’m happy. Isn’t that all you want for me?
lines.zh: : 为什么不？我很幸福。你对我所有的期望，不就是这个吗？

lines.en: scene daughterbath16
: Yes! It’s all I want for you! But you’re making it sound like I endorse what you’re doing just because it’s exactly what I did!
lines.zh: : 对！这是我对你的全部期望！可你把话说得好像我赞成你在做的事，就因为它跟我当年做的一模一样！

lines.en: : Do you not?...
lines.zh: : 你难道不赞成吗？……

lines.en: : No! I just...
lines.zh: : 不！我只是……

lines.en: scene daughterbath17
: I know I can’t tell you not to. Because I...I don’t want to take your free will away when I’ve done nothing but reap the benefits of the poor choices I’ve made in the past.
lines.zh: : 我知道我没法叫你别做。因为我……我不想剥夺你的自由意志，毕竟我过去做的那些糟糕选择，只让我尝到了甜头。

lines.en: : Right. Which is what the other girls won’t understand about us.
lines.zh: : 对。这正是别的女孩不会懂我们的地方。

lines.en: : You see me as more than just your daughter. You see me as an equal.
lines.zh: : 你不只把我当女儿看。你把我当成一个平等的人。

lines.en: scene daughterbath18
: No, Sana...I see you as my daughter and only my daughter. It’s the most important thing in the world to me, so tying any other role to that is-
lines.zh: : 不，Sana……我只把你当女儿，仅此而已。这是世上对我来说最重要的事，所以把任何别的角色绑在上面都——

lines.en: : Sorry...if you see me as only your daughter, why were you sitting outside of my door masturbating while I had sex with Sensei the other night?
lines.zh: : 抱歉……如果你只把我当女儿，那前两天晚上 Sensei 和我做爱的时候，你坐在我门外自慰是怎么回事？

lines.en: scene daughterbath19
: You...
: You heard that?...
lines.zh: : 你听到了？……

lines.en: scene daughterbath20
: Mhm. That’s why I pulled Sensei in for round two. It was a power move.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。所以我才把 Sensei 拉进来打了第二轮。那是一记权力操作。

lines.en: : Ah...I...oh God...um-
lines.zh: : 啊……我……哦天哪……呃——

lines.en: scene daughterbath21
: You don’t have to feel bad about it, Mom. I’ve done it too.
lines.zh: : 你不必为此内疚，妈。我也做过。

lines.en: scene daughterbath22
: What do you mean you’ve done it too?! You hate that I’ve been seeing Sensei! You hate how I-
lines.zh: : 你也做过是什么意思？！你明明讨厌我在跟 Sensei 交往！你讨厌我怎么——

lines.en: : Shh...don’t be too loud or everyone here will find out how naughty we are...
lines.zh: : 嘘……别太大声，不然这儿所有人都会发现我们有多下流……

lines.en: scene daughterbath23
: Have you really been...listening to us like that?...
lines.zh: : 你真的……一直那样听我们？……

lines.en: : Mhm...
lines.zh: : 嗯哼……

lines.en: scene daughterbath24
: I won’t lie...I hated it at first...listening to you go at it for hours...and hours...
lines.zh: : 我不骗你……一开始我很讨厌……听你们一搞就是好几个小时……好几个小时……

lines.en: : Then one day, I got so tired of it that I told myself I was going to go up there and give you two a piece of my mind...
lines.zh: : 后来有一天，我实在受不了了，就告诉自己要上楼去，好好说你们俩一顿……

lines.en: scene daughterbath25
: But when I made it upstairs...when I finally made it to the door...and knew that right behind it...my teacher was having his way with someone who looked just like me?...
lines.zh: : 可等我上了楼……等我终于走到那扇门前……知道就在门后……我的老师正在对那个长得和我一模一样的人为所欲为？……

lines.en: : Let’s just say my hand gained a mind of its own.
lines.zh: : 只能说，我的手自己有了主张。

lines.en: : Oh my God...I had no idea...I’m sorry, Sana...I’m sorry...I never should have done that in the house...I never should have-
lines.zh: : 天哪……我不知道……对不起，Sana……对不起……我不该在家里做那种事……我不该——

lines.en: : Again, you’re not getting it.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，你没懂。

lines.en: scene daughterbath26
: It doesn’t bother me. And the only reason it’s bothering you is because you’re blaming yourself for stuff that’s beyond your control, Mom.
lines.zh: : 我不介意。而你之所以介意，只是因为你在为那些超出你控制的事自责，妈。

lines.en: : I’d have slept with Sensei no matter what you did because something inside us just makes us...hungry.
lines.zh: : 不管你做什么，我都会跟 Sensei 上床，因为我们体内有某种东西，就是让我们……饥渴。

lines.en: : ...Hungry?
: I know you feel it...that...heat...
lines.zh: : 我知道你感受得到……那股……热……

lines.en: : That never-ending need to let someone else in and help you feel all those things you can’t make yourself feel. And I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 那种永无止境的、想让别人进来、帮你感受那些你自己无法让自己感受到的东西的需求。还有，对不起。

lines.en: : I’m sorry I ever blamed you for acting on those feelings with Sensei...if I had only known how much you were hurting, I would have never been mad at all.
lines.zh: : 对不起，我曾经因为你顺从了那些感觉、跟 Sensei 做了那些事而责怪你……要是我早知道你有多痛苦，我绝不会生气的。

lines.en: : Don’t look at me like that...like you’re disappointed in me...
lines.zh: : 别那样看我……像对我失望一样……

lines.en: : Sana, I’m...not disappointed...I’m just...I’m confused...
lines.zh: : Sana，我不是……不是失望……我只是……我只是困惑……

lines.en: : I...understand wanting to act on your feelings...I understand needing someone else to feel...whole...
lines.zh: : 我……理解想要顺从自己的感觉……理解需要别人才能感觉……完整……

lines.en: : What I don’t understand is what compelled you to ask me to join you...that’s what hurts. Because it...
lines.zh: : 我不理解的是，是什么驱使你叫我加入……那才是让我难受的地方。因为那……

lines.en: : It feels like...
lines.zh: : 感觉就像……

lines.en: : Feels like what?...
lines.zh: : 感觉像什么？……

lines.en: scene daughterbath27
: It feels like you don’t respect me...
lines.zh: : 感觉就像你不尊重我……

lines.en: : That’s not it...
lines.zh: : 不是那样……

lines.en: : And also that you know I can’t ever say no to you.
lines.zh: : 还像你知道我永远没法拒绝你。

lines.en: scene daughterbath28
: Okay...that one...might be a little true.
lines.zh: : 好吧……那一条……也许有点对。

lines.en: : How can you just take advantage of me like that?...Did you not think about my feelings at all?...How I’d feel watching my daughter fuck my boyfriend in front of my best friend?
lines.zh: : 你怎么能就这么利用我？……你一点都没考虑过我的感受吗？……看着我女儿在我最好的朋友面前操我男朋友，我会是什么感受？

lines.en: scene daughterbath29
: Sensei’s not your boyfriend, Mom.
lines.zh: : Sensei 不是你男朋友，妈。

lines.en: : Well...whatever he is! Do you have any idea the emotional whiplash that caused me?! How am I supposed to face Haruka now?!
lines.zh: : 行……不管他是什么！你知道那让我情绪上受到了多大的冲击吗？！我现在该怎么面对 Haruka？！

lines.en: : I imagine it’d be...pretty easy since Haruka was invited too...
lines.zh: : 我想……应该挺容易的，因为 Haruka 也被邀请了……

lines.en: : That’s beside the point! You can’t just...ask your mother to...do things like that with you! You didn’t even talk to me first! You just threw me to the wolves and let them devour me!
lines.zh: : 那不是重点！你不能就这么……叫你妈妈跟你……做那种事！你连先跟我说一声都没有！你直接把我扔进狼群，任它们把我撕碎！

lines.en: : You’re right. But I’m talking to you now.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。可我现在不是在跟你谈吗。

lines.en: : Don’t do it, Sana. Really. Don’t-
lines.zh: : 别这样，Sana。真的。别——

lines.en: : Let’s have a threesome with Sensei. Let’s show him that there’s a real family waiting for him and all he needs to do is accept us.
lines.zh: : 我们和 Sensei 玩 3P 吧。让他看看，有个真正的家在等他，他只要接受我们就行。

lines.en: scene daughterbath30
: Mnh...
lines.zh: : 嗯唔……

lines.en: : You’re not a bad mom...you’ve been exactly what I need. I’m the one who’s been a letdown. So if anyone is-
lines.zh: : 你不是坏妈妈……你一直都是我需要的那个人。让我失望的是我。所以如果有人要——

lines.en: : Please don’t...go putting yourself down or...taking any of the blame, Sana...
lines.zh: : 求你了，别……贬低你自己，或者……把责任往自己身上揽，Sana……

lines.en: : No matter how you look at this, it all comes back to me...
lines.zh: : 不管怎么看，这一切都绕回我身上……

lines.en: : I’ve failed you. I’ve failed you and...created a world where your perception of what’s right and wrong is so warped that you see no issue at all in inviting me into an incestuous polycule.
lines.zh: : 我辜负了你。我辜负了你，还……创造了一个世界，在那里你的是非观扭曲到觉得邀请我加入一段乱伦的多角关系根本不算什么。

lines.en: : It’s not that I can’t see what’s right and wrong, Mom...
lines.zh: : 妈，不是我看不清是非……

lines.en: : I just don’t care.
lines.zh: : 我只是不在乎。

lines.en: scene daughterbath31
: How?...Why?...
lines.zh: : 怎么会？……为什么？……

lines.en: : Because I tried to live that way and I hated it. I hated everyone else having fun while I struggled all alone in the dark.
lines.zh: : 因为我试着那样活过，而我恨透了。我恨别人都在快活，而我一个人在黑暗里挣扎。

lines.en: : You have never been alone. I have always been there, Sana. I will always be there.
lines.zh: : 你从来都不是一个人。我一直都在，Sana。我永远都会在。

lines.en: : That’s not what I mean and you know it.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思，你心里清楚。

lines.en: scene daughterbath32
